name: echo birth of venus
description: Proposal, after Sandro Botticelli, The Birth of Venus (about 1485, public domain), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x): the ECHO creature stands on a pale pink scallop shell riding the swell of a blue sea whose wave curls scroll past, and blinks; a little cloud creature in the top left corner with its own visor and eyes fills its cheeks and blows, wind streaks stream over the creature's head, its antenna bends with the wind and pings, its eyes shut happy and pink roses tumble across in front of it and drop toward the sea, then the cloud goes slack and all settles back to the rest; judge whether it reads at a glance as the painting, whether the shell reads as a scallop, whether the wind and the bending antenna read as a breeze, and whether it is still this creature.
